motions.item_title: Approve the minutes. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to approve the minutes. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Earlier minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the minutes of an earlier meeting, though the record does not say which one.
motions.impact: Approving minutes makes the written record of a past meeting official. You will not see any effect from it.

motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting motions to approve Item 7. A. Atkinson Accessory Dwelling Unit Exception. Commissioner Allen seconded the Motion.
motions.headline: Accessory apartment exception for the Atkinson property
motions.summary: The commission approved an exception for an accessory dwelling unit, such as a basement or backyard apartment, on the Atkinson property.
motions.impact: One household is directly affected, plus perhaps its immediate neighbors. The record gives no address and does not say which rule was waived.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the General Plan Future Land Use Map for Certain Lands Known as Steeplechase South. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council on Item 7. B. An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the General Plan Future Land Use Map for Certain Lands Known as Steeplechase South. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New planned land use for Steeplechase South
motions.summary: The commission recommended changing the city's long-range land use map for the area known as Steeplechase South.
motions.impact: This map guides what kind of building the city will later allow there. The motion does not say what the new designation is, and the council makes the final call.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7. C. Site Plan- The District Lot 3. Commissione…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7. C. Site Plan- The District Lot 3. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Site plan for Lot 3 at The District
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council approve the site plan for Lot 3 at The District.
motions.impact: The motion does not describe what would be built on the lot. People near The District should watch for the council vote, which decides whether the plan goes ahead.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 16.35.140 Diagrams. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council on Item 7.D. An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 16.35.140 Diagrams. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Update to diagrams in the subdivision code
motions.summary: The commission recommended amending the diagrams section of the city's subdivision code, chapter 16.35.140.
motions.impact: Engineers and developers drawing up new subdivisions are the ones who use these diagrams. A homeowner is unlikely to notice, and the council still has to vote on it.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.40.020 Land Use Table. Commissioner Fox seconded the motion
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council of Item 7.E. An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.40.020 Land Use Table. Commissioner Fox seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Change to the city's table of allowed land uses
motions.summary: The commission recommended a change to the city code's land use table, which lists the uses allowed in each zone.
motions.impact: The record does not name the uses being added, removed or moved. Whatever the change is, it waits on a City Council vote before it applies to any property.

motions.item_title: Forward a positive recommendation to the City Council on Item 7. F. Harmony DA Section 7 and 8.…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council on Item 7. F. Harmony DA Section 7 and 8. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Harmony development agreement, sections 7 and 8
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council approve sections 7 and 8 of the Harmony development agreement.
motions.impact: The motion does not say what those sections cover. The council has the final vote, so nothing changes for Harmony residents or builders until it acts.
